summary: Frontend E2E for AI screening findings + patient sharing + doctor-side screening card + briefing citations. All 9 review scenarios passed. Verified: (1) Patient Noura ran a fresh screening (new-screening-btn -> 3 chat messages describing headaches -> generate-report-btn) and the PDF (sihha-health-screening-report.pdf) downloaded plus the share-screening-card appeared in the left column. (2) share-visit-select offered Noura's single upcoming visit (enc_8eb16f42b750, 8/20/2026 Dr. Layla), share-screening-btn fired the success toast and the card was replaced by screening-shared-confirmation reading 'Shared with Dr. Layla Haddad for the visit on 8/20/2026.'. (3) Doctor Layla opened /doctor/encounters/enc_8eb16f42b750 (route is /doctor/encounters/:id, not /doctor/encounter/) and screening-section titled 'AI Screenings' rendered with 2 reports newest-first; the shared report showed shared-badge-report_66ccbfd09e00 = 'Shared for this visit', toggle-report expanded it to 2 findings each with a symptom label + severity + patient's quoted words (verbatim: 'I have been getting headaches every afternoon for the past week; tight pressure around the forehead, about 5 out of 10' and 'I also feel more tired than usual'), no diagnostic language. (4) toggle-excerpt-<fid> exposed the underlying Patient messages, labelled 'Patient:'. ask-about-<fid> correctly showed 'Generate the briefing first' info toast because no briefing existed yet. (5) symptom-timeline did NOT render because the two Noura screenings mention disjoint symptoms (chest tightness in the first, headaches/tiredness in the second) — explicitly noted per spec rather than marked failed. (6) generate-briefing-btn produced a v4 briefing that cited 4 concern-screening blocks (concern-screening-0-find_a196ad5028 headaches, concern-screening-0-find_bb6db44a43 tiredness, concern-screening-2-find_ad5a205c24 chest tightness) each labelled 'From the AI screening' with 8/19/2026 date and the patient's verbatim words. concern-intake blocks were empty because Noura's intake is unanswered — consistent (no answers yet to cite). (7) Stale badge: Hashim's only report is dated 2026-07-16 (34 days old), well under the 90-day threshold, so stale-badge is correctly absent — noted rather than failed per spec. (8) toggle-role-btn was hidden for patient (Noura) and doctor (Dr. Layla) accounts and PRESENT for admin@sihha.ai ('Switch to Patient' visible) — button not clicked. (9) Regressions passed: Noura dashboard shows vitals (HR/BP/glucose/spo2/temp) and intake-prompt-card, /doctor/schedule loads for Layla, Omar's signed briefing enc_1a4e941c523b renders read-only (signature-line present, no regenerate or sign buttons).
critical_code_review_comments: ShareScreeningCard is only rendered when HealthChat.lastReport is truthy (in-memory state). If the patient reloads /chat after generating a report but before sharing, the share card disappears and there is no way to share that report from the UI — the report is downloaded but effectively orphaned. Consider persisting 'unshared reports' in a list on the sidebar so the patient can still share after refresh.
ScreeningCard shows all reports for the patient (not just the ones shared with the current encounter), which is the correct product decision; the shared-badge disambiguates. Confirmed working.

EncounterDetail generate-briefing-btn does not surface a stale-briefing hint or auto-regen when a NEW screening is shared after a briefing already exists (analogous to the intake pre-existing-briefing gap flagged in iteration_5). Not observed here because Noura had no briefing yet, but worth guarding.
toggle-role-btn correctly hidden for non-admin roles (ALLOW_SELF_ROLE_CHANGE=false); admin sees it as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created TWO screenings for Noura during this run under enc_8eb16f42b750: (a) an initial chest-tightness screening (report ~report_a0ec9b821830) that was NOT shared (used to seed the multi-report view), and (b) a headaches/tiredness screening (report_66ccbfd09e00) that WAS shared with enc_8eb16f42b750. A v4 briefing was then generated on enc_8eb16f42b750 (previously briefing-empty-state) and it now cites 4 screening findings across chief concerns. Noura's intake for that encounter remains unanswered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route is /doctor/encounters/:id (plural). Noura's enc_8eb16f42b750 now has a briefing that cites screening findings and 2 screenings (one shared, one not). Hashim's report_47396c56cec8 is 34 days old — do NOT expect stale-badge unless >90 days. When testing the ask-about-<fid> action from ScreeningCard, if no briefing exists it fires an info toast 'Generate the briefing first'; if one exists it appends a Q into the follow-up panel — was not tested with a briefing present in this run because the toast appeared before briefing generation and after generation the test window closed; suggested for a next run.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works end to end.
